note: Ground truth labelled by a Claude agent from the Muse Voice Transcribe narration and 1 fps frames, blind to the model's plan; not yet human-reviewed. Uncertain: the tip wetting/tinning (115-128) is mostly off-board and hard to see from above, the clip-into-stand step may or may not count as a learner step, and the touch-up of the first joint (157-163) could be merged into soldering that joint.

steps.instruction: Dab flux paste from the Plusivo soldering paste tub onto the holes of the green perfboard.
steps.done_looks_like: A glossy film of yellow flux paste covers the target holes on the perfboard.
steps.evidence: Transcript 'get some paste or flux and put it on the holes'; t=37-38 Plusivo SOLDERING PASTE lid, t=39-41 finger in the open yellow paste tub, t=42-47 finger rubbing paste onto the board. The 'get a soldering board' segment (23-36) only shows the board in hand, so it is left out as a supply item.

steps.instruction: Push the blue resistor's two leads through two holes and seat it flat against the board.
steps.done_looks_like: The blue resistor body sits flush on the top of the board with both leads poking out the underside.
steps.evidence: Transcript 'put it through and get it through the board ... push it all the way through flip it on over'; t=50-53 resistor in palm, t=54-62 threading the leads, t=63-78 pushing it home (a second, earlier resistor is already on the board), t=79 board flipped.

steps.instruction: On the underside, bend the two resistor leads outward along the board so the resistor holds itself in place, and smear a little paste on them.
steps.done_looks_like: Both leads lie bent flat and spread apart along the solder side, the resistor no longer slipping back.
steps.evidence: Transcript at 77.3 'spread the leads down ... push those down and spread them out and I'm spreading a little bit of the soldering paste on it'; t=80-92 fingers bending the leads on the underside, t=93-95 board turned to check.

steps.instruction: Clip the board, solder side up, into the helping-hands alligator clip.
steps.done_looks_like: The perfboard hangs flat in the alligator clip with the bent leads facing the camera.
steps.evidence: Transcript 'clip it back onto my little stand'; t=96-103 board placed into the alligator clip, held there from t=100.

steps.instruction: Wipe the soldering iron tip on the wet yellow sponge, then tin it with a little solder.
steps.done_looks_like: The iron tip is clean and shiny with a thin coat of solder.
steps.evidence: Transcript at 117 'wet your tip on the sponge ... get a bit of solder on your tip ... tinning your tip'; t=116-119 iron tip at the yellow sponge, t=122-125 solder wire and iron briefly in shot. The tinning itself is barely visible. The iron and temperature talk at 105-111 is left out as talking with nothing done.

steps.instruction: Heat the first lead's joint on the bottom row with the iron for about three seconds and feed solder in until it fills the pad.
steps.done_looks_like: The bottom-row lead's hole is filled with a solder joint.
steps.evidence: Transcript 'heat up the joint ... about three seconds and then we're going to touch the solder ... it fills up'; t=133-142 solder wire and iron at the joint at the end of the bottom-row lead, t=143-144 joint done with tools out of shot.

steps.instruction: Solder the second lead's joint on the upper row the same way.
steps.done_looks_like: Both lead holes now have solder joints.
steps.evidence: t=145-152 iron at the upper-row joint, t=153-156 both joints visible with no tools. Not narrated separately; split from the first joint because each joint is its own visible end state.

steps.instruction: Reheat the first, bottom-row joint and add a little more solder until it is shiny.
steps.done_looks_like: The bottom-row joint is a full, shiny solder fillet.
steps.evidence: Transcript 'the first one I didn't get as well as I wanted to so I'm going to go back and add a little bit more ... nice shiny solder'; t=157-161 iron and solder back on the bottom-row joint, t=162-163 finished. Could be merged with step 6, but it is not contiguous with it.

steps.instruction: Snip the excess resistor leads off flush with the joints using the flush cutters.
steps.done_looks_like: Only short trimmed stubs remain at the two solder joints, with no long leads hanging off.
steps.evidence: Transcript 'clip your leads off'; t=164-173 black flush cutters cutting both leads, t=174-176 close-up of the trimmed joints. The 177-191 segment is the finished board shown off (outro), so it is left out.
